metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 1992 · Universal Soldier
metas.description: Soldiers who were killed in action are brought back to life in a top secret military experiment that creates superhuman warriors.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 2.9 · 1998 · Universal Soldier II: Brothers in Arms
metas.description: The Universal Soldiers are used to smuggle diamonds for a CIA Director, but Luc Deveraux continues to cause him problems.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.0 · 1998 · Universal Soldier III: Unfinished Business
metas.description: When reporter Veronica Roberts unwillingly gets involved in a hostage situation and is forced to escape, she and Luc Devereaux go into hiding. Meanwhile, Dr. Walker and Mentor get set with a powerful new Universal Soldier and a lethal plan.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.2 · 1999 · Universal Soldier: The Return
metas.description: The "universal soldiers" must fight the whole army, when the military's supercomputer S.E.T.H gets out of control.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 5.3 · 2009 · Universal Soldier: Regeneration
metas.description: When terrorists threaten nuclear catastrophe at Chernobyl, the world's only hope is to reactivate decommissioned Universal Soldier Luc Deveraux.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 5.1 · 2012 · Universal Soldier: Day of Reckoning
metas.description: John looks to take down Luc Deveraux after a home invasion claims his wife and daughter. The fight pits John against Andrew Scott and an army of genetically enhanced warriors; meanwhile, he must contend with a UniSol in relentless...
